if: a tax invoice or similar document was issued under another Act for the time being in force
it is in respect of a non-taxable supply
then: that document SHALL be treated as a bill of supply for the purposes of the Act
note: A document that does not look like a GST bill of supply can still BE one. Rejecting it for missing rule 49 particulars would be wrong.

evidence.quote: Provided further that any tax invoice or any other similar document issued under any other Act for the time being in force in respect of any non-taxable supply shall be treated as a bill of supply for the purposes of the Act.
